name: Decimator 397 series assassin droid
description: The Decimator 397 series assassin droids were frighteningly tall assassin droids with dull black bodies. They had sharp angles, and long, dagger-like fingers. The head of the droid looked vaguely humanoid and it had thin eye slits with a heavy metal "brow", which gave it the appearance of looking very hard for something. All of these droids came equipped with a single blaster cannon and a concussion missile launcher. When deactivated, they had a thin wire running from the base of their neck into nearby wall ports which were often hooked into security computers.
